stated: The Conservative Party will bring penalties for dangerous cyclists who kill or injure into line with those for other road users.

source.quote: While we back responsible cyclists, we will bring penalties for the rare instances where dangerous cyclists kill or injure into line with those for other road users.

bearing_set.reason: The policy directly addresses criminal penalties for dangerous cycling causing death or injury — a sentencing/justice measure that affects deterrence and victim justice outcomes, squarely within the safety and justice scope of O5.

membership_note: Single-target policy aimed at closing a specific legal gap in road-crime sentencing. No other fundamental clears the non-negligible bar: the liberty cost of criminalising dangerous cycling causing death or injury is negligible (analogous to existing road-traffic offences), there is no material fiscal, distributional, or environmental mechanism, and equal-treatment (O9) concerns the anti-discrimination/minority-protection dimension of rights rather than parity of criminal penalties between road-user types.
